conflicts_and_limits: MCP-017 handler context is not passed into the displayed pipeline scan call.
MCP-018 readable output does not prove full scope scan; MCP-019/020 resource encoding has a separate read failure boundary.
MCP-021/022 client roots are location hints, not containment or authority evidence.
MCP-024 entrypoint HTTP security is not configured explicitly; dependency/runtime controls remain unverified.
Embedded reporting prompts preserve upstream authority separately from local adoption, actual metrics and policy decisions.
